name: Alligo AB (publ)
summary: Alligo AB (publ) provides workwear, personal protection, tools, and consumables in Sweden, Norway, and Finland. The company offers personal protective equipment and clothing, such as workwear, shoes, gloves, protective equipment, profile clothing, and accessories; and tools, including machines, hand tools, power tools, and measuring tools, as well as cutting, grinding, and drilling tools.
